model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the change in "Informativeness" across four discrete points on the x-axis, labeled 0 through 4, for two methods: "0-CoT" and "CoRe". The y-axis, labeled "Informativeness", ranges from 0.920 to 0.950 on a linear scale. The "0-CoT" method is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, starting at a value of approximately 0.951 at x=0 and decreasing steadily to approximately 0.918 at x=4. The "CoRe" method is represented by an orange solid line with triangular markers, starting at approximately 0.952 at x=0, remaining nearly level until x=1, then decreasing sharply to approximately 0.938 at x=2, and continuing its decline to approximately 0.918 at x=4. Both lines converge at the final point (x=4) with the same y-value.
